[[File:Weapon frame detail.png|100px|left]]
A '''weapon frame''' can be obtained as a drop from any monster in the [[Gauntlet]]. The weapon frame is used to create the lowest tier [[Crystal halberd (basic)|crystal halberd]], [[Crystal bow (basic)|bow]], or [[Crystal staff (basic)|staff]]. These items can be attuned to tier 2 by using 50 [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]]. Depending on which weapon is created, the attuned weapons can be perfected to tier 3 by using a unique item (either the [[crystal spike]], [[crystal orb|orb]] or [[crystalline bowstring|bowstring]]).
